links.outcome: Critical error rate of GPT-4 ECG interpretation and patient management in emergency scenarios
links.effect: Critical errors in 46% of ECG interpretations (OSCE) and 50% (PubMed); management critical errors 32% (OSCE) and 14% (PubMed); approached 50% when ECG evaluations were included.
links.quote: GPT-4 made critical errors in 46% of ECG interpretations in the OSCE group and 50% in the PubMed group.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4's performance on clinical vignettes (ECG interpretation and emergency patient management plans) reviewed by specialists; it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
